rules.goal.title: Keep them floating
rules.goal.body: Your character floats under {max} balloons. Guess the secret word before they all pop!
rules.guess.title: Guessing
rules.guess.body: Tap a letter. If it's in the word, every copy of it shows up. If it isn't, a balloon pops. Each letter can only be tried once.
rules.help.title: A little help
rules.help.body: Every word starts with a few letters showing. The word's description is always visible for free to help you guess. On the first levels, some letters that aren't in the word are taken off the keyboard.
rules.hard.title: Harder words
rules.hard.body: From level {lettersLevel}, you can reveal {letterCount} hidden letters for {letterCost} tokens, once per word. From level {subjectLevel}, the word's subject is shown for free.
rules.tokens.title: Tokens
rules.tokens.body: Every word you guess pays tokens, and harder levels pay more. Guess {streak} words in a row for a bonus. Spend tokens on letters and new characters.
rules.levels.title: Levels
rules.levels.body: There are {levels} levels, and the words get harder as you climb. Lose {drop} words in a row and you step back one level. You'll be back up in no time!
rules.board.title: Leaderboard
rules.board.body: Your score is the number of words you've guessed. Spending tokens never lowers it.
credits.intro: The English words use the sources below. The other languages have their own word banks and original clues.
credits.wordnet.title: Open English WordNet
credits.wordnet.body: Each English word description is based on a definition from Open English WordNet 2025, © the Open English WordNet contributors, based on Princeton WordNet 3.0 (© Princeton University). Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Changes made: the definitions are reworded in plain, shorter English for the game, so they never give the answer away; for some words, the description uses a more common meaning than the one in the dictionary.

versus.title: Versus
versus.modes.rush.name: Word Rush
versus.modes.rush.rules: Everyone gets the same words in the same order. Guess as many as you can before the {time} clock runs out. Each word allows {misses} misses, and you can skip one you're stuck on. Most words wins; on a tie, fewer misses, then whoever got there first.
versus.modes.battle.name: Balloon Battle
versus.modes.battle.rules: Everyone floats under {balloons} balloons and plays the same words. A miss pops one of your balloons. Every word you guess pops one of the leader's balloons, or two if you made no miss. Skipping a word costs a balloon. The last one still floating wins.
versus.modes.duel.name: Word Duel
versus.modes.duel.tagline: Pick a word for your rival
versus.modes.duel.rules: One against one. Each round, you both pick a word for the other (one of your cards, or type your own), then you both guess at the same time. Guessing your word beats missing it; then fewer misses wins, then the faster. Best of {rounds} rounds.
